# Payment Term (Cin7 Core API v2)

Group `Payment Term` of the Cin7 Core API reference. Base URL `https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalApi/v2/`; every request carries the `api-auth-accountid` and `api-auth-applicationkey` headers (see `../api-basics.md`). 4 actions on 1 resources, 1 field tables.

| Action | Path |
|---|---|
| [GET](#get-ref-paymentterm) | `GET /ref/paymentterm?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&ID={ID}&Name={Name}&Method={Method}&IsActive={IsActive}&IsDefault={IsDefault}` |
| [POST](#post-ref-paymentterm) | `POST /ref/paymentterm` |
| [PUT](#put-ref-paymentterm) | `PUT /ref/paymentterm` |
| [DELETE](#delete-ref-paymentterm) | `DELETE /ref/paymentterm?ID={ID}` |


Payment Term CRUD operations

### Available Fields for Payment Term
| Property      | Type      | Length    | Required  | Notes                                 |
|:--------------|-----------|-----------|-----------|---------------------------------------|
| `ID`          | Guid      |           |           | Unique Payment Term ID.               |
| `Name`        | String    | 256       | Yes       | Name of Payment Term.                 |
| `Duration`    | Int       |           |           | Minimum Payment Term duration in days |
| `Method`      | String    |           |           | Method of Payment Term. Should be one of the following values: `number of days`, `day of next month`, `last day of next month`, `days since the end of the month` |
| `IsActive`    | Bool      |           |           | Points that Payment Term is Active. `True` as default for POST. |
| `IsDefault`   | Bool      |           |           | Points that Payment Term is Default. `False` as default for POST. |

## Payment Term

Path: `/ref/paymentterm`

<a id="get-ref-paymentterm"></a>
### GET /ref/paymentterm?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&ID={ID}&Name={Name}&Method={Method}&IsActive={IsActive}&IsDefault={IsDefault}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `ID` (optional, Guid): Only return Payment Term with the specific ID
- `Name` (optional, string): Only return Payment Terms that start with the specific Name
- `Method` (optional, string): Only return Payment Terms with the specific Method
- `IsActive` (optional, bool): Only return Payment Terms which are marked as active.
- `IsDefault` (optional, bool): Only return Payment Terms which are marked as default.

Response 200:

```json
{
  "Total": 3,
  "Page": 1,
  "PaymentTermList": [
    {
      "ID": "e6c25fa9-bb14-45b2-afe7-428e454663ef",
      "Name": "10 days since end of month",
      "Duration": 10,
      "Method": "days since the end of the month",
      "IsActive": true,
      "IsDefault": false
    },
    {
      "ID": "927a7013-e1d9-4194-a547-28b1b4c6b413",
      "Name": "30 days",
      "Duration": 30,
      "Method": "number of days",
      "IsActive": true,
      "IsDefault": false
    },
    {

      "Duration": 10,
      "Method": "last day of next month",
      "IsActive": true,
      "IsDefault": false
    }
  ]
}
```
